New Traffic Signal Timing Coming Soon at SR 332/Park One
Posted on October 15, 2026
The new traffic signals at Park One on McGalliard Road (State Road 332) will transition to the newly installed sensors next week. This upgrade is expected to improve signal timing and address some of the issues reported by motorists.
Article: GIS-Driven Emergency Response and Damage Assessment During the August 2026 Delaware County Flood Event
Posted on October 2, 2026
Read about how the Delaware County Office of Information and Emergency Management Agency leveraged GIS Technology to help respond to the August flood disaster. Flood Response GIS Article

I&M Planning East Indiana Grid Reliability Project; Public Open Houses Scheduled
Posted on October 1, 2026
Indiana Michigan Power (I&M) is developing a new electric transmission project designed to strengthen overall grid reliability. Potential routes for the project include areas within Delaware County as part of a larger transmission line extending from the Greentown Station near Kokomo eastward into Ohio. The final location of the transmission line has not been determined....
